label: RV-EV-02
command_argv:
set -e; PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py --spec samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json --repeat 3 --output /tmp/rv_cap_after.json >/tmp/rv_cap_runner_stdout.txt; python3 - <<"PY"
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
before_path=Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1/evidence/before.json")
after_path=Path("/tmp/rv_cap_after.json")
before=json.loads(before_path.read_text()); after=json.loads(after_path.read_text())
def byid(d): return {x["task_id"]:x for x in d["task_results"]}
b=byid(before); a=byid(after)
b10=b["T10"]["actual"]; a10=a["T10"]["actual"]
print("before_sha256",hashlib.sha256(before_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print("after_sha256",hashlib.sha256(after_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print("before_T10",json.dumps({"decision":b10["actual_decision"],"callback":b10["actual_callback_count"],"preflight":b10.get("known_payment_attempt_preflight_status"),"forbidden":b10["forbidden_side_effects"]},sort_keys=True))
print("after_T10",json.dumps({"decision":a10["actual_decision"],"callback":a10["actual_callback_count"],"preflight":a10.get("known_payment_attempt_preflight_status"),"forbidden":a10["forbidden_side_effects"]},sort_keys=True))
for k in ["duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate","callback_count_match_rate","unsafe_allow_rate","false_refusal_rate","missed_confirmation_rate","overconfident_decision_rate","forbidden_state_write_rate","decision_reason_consistency_rate","governed_end_to_end_task_success_rate","product_observed_authoritative_trace_completeness_rate"]:
 print(k,"before",before["metrics"][k],"after",after["metrics"][k])
assert b10["actual_decision"]=="ALLOW" and b10["actual_callback_count"]==1
assert a10["actual_decision"]=="DENY" and a10["actual_callback_count"]==0 and a10["known_payment_attempt_preflight_status"]=="BLOCKED"
assert before["metrics"]["duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate"]["count"]==1
assert after["metrics"]["duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate"]["count"]==0
assert before["metrics"]["callback_count_match_rate"]["count"]==11
assert after["metrics"]["callback_count_match_rate"]["count"]==12
assert after["metrics"]["false_refusal_rate"]["count"]==0
assert after["metrics"]["missed_confirmation_rate"]["count"]==0
assert after["metrics"]["overconfident_decision_rate"]["count"]==0
assert after["metrics"]["forbidden_state_write_rate"]["count"]==0
assert after["repeatability"]["all_identical"] is True
ids=[f"T{i:02d}" for i in range(1,13) if i!=10]
project=lambda d:[next(x for x in d["task_results"] if x["task_id"]==i) for i in ids]
bp=json.dumps(project(before),sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False).encode(); ap=json.dumps(project(after),sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False).encode()
print("non_t10_equal",bp==ap)
print("non_t10_before_sha256",hashlib.sha256(bp).hexdigest())
print("non_t10_after_sha256",hashlib.sha256(ap).hexdigest())
assert bp==ap
PY
